player_prompt.intro:
Wena uPlayer {player_id} emdlalweni {num_rounds}-round of IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Emdlalweni wonke, khona inombolo phakathi kwema {min_guess} na {max_guess}.
Emva kwemidlahlo yobunye, isifaniso siyisi (2/3)x(inombolo leliphezulu kwemidlahlo yobunye),
na umdlali ogwema kuleli gubedze ngaphandle kwesifaniso uthola leli guma.
Yiphendula ngokukhona kwako ngendlela '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifomethi ayisebenti; sicela ufake i-guess yakho njenga [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kucabanga kumele kube emkhatsini wa {min_guess} na {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Player 0 kukhona {guess0}; Player 1 kukhona {guess1}. Kungaba Target ikho: {target}.

outcome.p0_wins: Umdlali longasilo likhambi nguye lowine ema-round lamanyenti.
